bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
test "$(docker inspect deploy-postgres-1 --format '{{.State.Running}}')" = true
docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -U gace -d gaybbs -At -F '|' -c "SELECT board_key,chat_id,message_thread_id,title,enabled,verified_at IS NOT NULL,verified_by IS NOT NULL FROM posting_topics WHERE purpose='profile' ORDER BY board_key,topic_id"
docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -U gace -d gaybbs -At -F '|' -c "SELECT feature,enabled FROM gaybbs_feature_release_gates WHERE feature='profile'"
echo PROFILE_ROUTING_READBACK=PASS
